notes.title: warDrive Update 0.8.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The cursor should now feel much more responsive

notes.title: Minor Update 0.8.1 Available
notes.content:
Hey warDrivers! Here's an update for you.

[h1]Major Bug Fixes[/h1]
PhishyPhishy no longer crashes the game upon revealing a fish.

[h1]Major Improvements[/h1]
[h2]User Interface[/h2]
The position of the [i]Continue Mission[/i] and [i]Cruise[/i] buttons have been swapped.

[h2]Difficulty[/h2]
Overall, difficulty has increased.
Letting a hacked enemy survive too long will result in a raised security alert as always. Now, active enemies will engage if they were otherwise just passing through.

[h2]Item Cost Scaling[/h2]
The rate that Item costs increase has been reduced greatly.

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
Some upgrade item effect descriptions display incorrect values.

If you have played warDrive, please share your thoughts with me.

[url=https://www.bardicbytes.com/wardrive-early-access-survey]Early Access Survey[/url]

If you have a problem, please reach out to me! support@bardicbytes.com

notes.title: Early Access April Update
notes.content:
warDrive has been updated
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41776948/1510ca1300e2e4a4896a35f1444fb48232d0eeea.png[/img]

Major bug fixes have been addressed throughout the game.
New features and quality of life improvements have been implemented.

The most important change is that the save system has been thoroughly future proofed, however, current progress will be lost.

Any possible future changes to the save system will either not damage your save file or will automatically be converted to the new version.

[list]
[*] Vehicles move move smoothly. 
[*] Vehicles will now only crash into each other very rarely
[*] Incremental items have been balanced.
[*] All prologue narrative content has been added.
[/list]
